backend/main.mo: Main backend canister defining types, storage maps, access control, and query/update methods for exercises, blog posts, products, memberships, muscle groups, and user profiles.
backend/migration.mo: Migration module converting old actor state to a new structure by adding muscle group card data and returning the updated actor state.
feature_evidence.json: Report mapping feature requirements to affected frontend files, components, and test IDs with confidence levels.
frontend-file-summaries.txt: Pre-written summaries describing the purpose and behavior of key frontend files and components.
frontend/index.css: Global Tailwind-based CSS defining color variables, dark mode values, and base styling rules.
frontend/index.html: HTML entry point loading the root element and bootstrapping the frontend via main.tsx.
frontend/src/App.tsx: Application root configuring TanStack Router routes, theme provider, and global toasts.
frontend/src/components/creator/Affiliat: Admin interface to create, edit, validate, and delete Amazon affiliate products with dialogs and a products table.
frontend/src/components/creator/BlogMana: Admin tool for manually creating, editing, publishing, previewing, and deleting blog posts with validation and dialogs.
frontend/src/components/creator/Breathwo: Empty placeholder file for breathwork management functionality.
frontend/src/components/creator/Exercise: Admin UI for creating, editing, validating, and deleting exercises with muscle groups, equipment, media, and cues.
frontend/src/components/creator/MuscleGr: UI for viewing and editing muscle group cards, including form handling and saving updates via mutation.
frontend/src/components/Footer.tsx: Renders the site footer with brand info, navigation links, social icons, and a dynamic copyright.
frontend/src/components/Header.tsx: Provides the site header with logo, navigation, admin tools, authentication controls, and a responsive mobile menu.
frontend/src/components/Layout.tsx: Wraps the page with a header, footer, and main outlet container.
frontend/src/components/membership/Start: Button that creates a Stripe checkout session and redirects the user for membership purchase.
frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts: React hook that initializes and manages a backend actor based on Internet Identity authentication.
frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.t: Context provider and hooks for handling Internet Identity login, state management, and persistence.
frontend/src/hooks/useMusicPlayer.tsx: Zustand-based music player hook managing play state, volume, and an audio element.
frontend/src/hooks/useQueries.ts: Collection of React Query hooks for fetching and mutating exercises, muscle groups, user profiles, and related backend data.
frontend/src/index.css: Tailwind CSS setup with custom dark theme variables and utility classes for branding colors.
frontend/src/main.tsx: App entry point initializing React, query client, and Internet Identity provider before rendering the app.
frontend/src/pages/AboutPage.tsx: Renders the About page with hero imagery, founder biography, and styled sections using animated backgrounds.
frontend/src/pages/AffiliateStorePage.ts: Displays affiliate products with a hero section, optional disclosure, loading states, and a product grid sourced from queries.
frontend/src/pages/BlogPage.tsx: Shows blog post previews with hero visual, membership/admin-aware controls, loading states, and an articles grid.
frontend/src/pages/BlogPostPage.tsx: Renders a single blog post with hero metadata, membership gating, loading and not-found handling, and full or preview content.
frontend/src/pages/ContactPage.tsx: Presents contact information with hero visuals, a quote overlay, and support/training info cards with navigation buttons.
Admin-only dashboard with tabbed management sections for exercises, muscle groups, blog posts, and affiliate store items.
frontend/src/pages/HomePage.tsx: Public landing page featuring hero messaging, core principles, and navigation to membership and workout library.
frontend/src/pages/PaymentFailurePage.ts: Displays a payment failure message with options to retry checkout or contact support.
frontend/src/pages/PaymentSuccessPage.ts: Shows payment success status, refreshes membership data, and links to the dashboard or workout library.
frontend/src/pages/ProgramsPage.tsx: Showcases structured training programs, including a featured 7‑day challenge with purchase placeholder actions.
frontend/src/pages/UserDashboardPage.tsx: User dashboard handling login, membership status, profile setup, and account actions.
frontend/src/pages/WorkoutLibraryPage.ts: Workout library displaying muscle group cards, exercise previews, and membership-gated content.
frontend/src/utils/urlParams.ts: Provides helpers to read URL params (including hash-based), persist them in sessionStorage, and manage stored values; includes utilities for cleaning sensitive params from the URL.
frontend/tailwind.config.js: Configures Tailwind with OKLCH-based theme tokens, extended animations, typography/container/animate plugins, and project-specific colors and layout settings.
project_state.json: Stores the project's state, architecture notes, known issues, and implemented features for tracking the evolving ICP-based membership and content platform.
